sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜) is a optional encounter in Mandate Encampment, found at Path of the Baishan's Fall. Beating it yields Soft Snake Sword.

sections.title: Where to Find the Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜)
sections.content:

Appears in: Mandate Encampment.

Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not run an elemental damage system, so there is no weakness table to fill in - nothing here is estimated from how a boss looks, which is exactly how wrong weakness tables get written.

What the game does have is a colour language on enemy attacks, and it is the single most useful thing to learn: a red flash marks an unblockable attack that must be dodged, a blue flash marks a parryable one that should be deflected, and a purple flash means the boss has just parried you and a counter is coming. See the combat system for how Sha-Chi feeds into this.

sections.title: How to Beat the Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜)
sections.content:
Wu Lengshuang is a parry duel rather than a damage race. She deflects constantly, and every deflection is a purple flash that cancels your damage and leads straight into a counter whose colour tells you what to do: red means dodge, blue means parry, no colour means block or reposition.

The mistake that loses this fight is pressing through the purple flash. Treat it as a stop signal, react to the counter, and take the acrobatic flip slash as your one reliable Ghoststep opening.

Attacks worth knowing

AttackWhat it doesAnswer
Purple flashShe parries you mid-stringStop attacking immediately
Counter after purpleRed glint = unblockable, blue = parryableDodge the red, parry the blue
Two-handed swingOnly attack she uses two hands forAlways followed by an unblockable spin - dodge it
Acrobatic slashForward flip, wide slashParryable - this is your Ghoststep opening

What works

  • Stop attacking the moment the purple flash appears - that is her parry, and a counter is already coming.
  • Dodge when the follow-up glints red, parry when it glints blue.
  • Her only two-handed swing is always followed by an unblockable spinning slash.
  • The acrobatic forward flip slash is parryable and is her main gap closer.
